content.text:
Here is my thorough analysis of the owner-identity code in `/home/daniel/sandbox` (a Spring/OfficeFloor PetClinic variant). All paths are absolute.

## Important cross-cutting finding: "identity-v2" is a target contract, not yet implemented

The single acceptance test describes a v2 shape (`apiVersion: 2`, `memberId`/`identityKey`/`householdId` nested under an `identity` object) that the production code does NOT currently produce. Right now those three fields are emitted at the top level, and there is no `apiVersion` or `identity` object anywhere in `openapi.yml`, the generated `OwnerDto`, or `OwnerMapper`. A grep for `schemaVersion`/`apiVersion` across `src/main` returns nothing; the only hits are in the test. So this test is currently failing / describes work to be done.

---

## Derivation logic (the algorithms you asked for)

### Region code — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/Locality.java`
Derives the canonical region ("locality"). Postcode wins over city.
- `of(city)` → city-table only: `Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD`, else `"UNKNOWN"`.
- `of(city, postcode)` (lines 34-40): `PostcodeRanges.regionFor(postcode)` if non-null, else city table.
- `ofMemberId(memberId)` (lines 48-60): reads region back off the memberId by taking the leading run of letters. This is what the mapper uses for `locality`.

Postcode ranges — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/PostcodeRanges.java`: `NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099` (lines 13-16); `regionFor` requires exactly 4 digits (line 31).

### householdId — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/HouseholdId.java`
```java
public static String of(String lastName, String postcode) {
    String key = normalize(lastName) + "|" + (postcode == null ? "" : postcode);
    return Sha256.hex(key).substring(0, 12).toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
}
// normalize: trim, collapse \s+ to single space, toLowerCase
```
First 12 upper-case hex chars of SHA-256 over `normalizedLastName + "|" + postcode`. Shared by owners with same last name + postcode. Not persisted (derived in mapper).

### identityKey — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/IdentityKey.java`
```java
public static String of(String telephone, String email, String lastName) {
    String normalizedTelephone = TelephoneE164.normalizeOrNull(telephone);
    if (normalizedTelephone == null)
        normalizedTelephone = telephone == null ? "" : telephone.trim();
    String normalizedEmail = (email == null || email.isBlank())
            ? "" : email.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    String soundex = Soundex.of(lastName);
    return Sha256.hex(normalizedTelephone + "|" + normalizedEmail + "|" + soundex);
}
```
Full 64-char lower-case hex SHA-256 over `E164telephone + "|" + lowerEmail + "|" + soundex(lastName)`. Note: postcode is deliberately NOT part of the key, so same-household different-phone owners get distinct keys (soft match, not hard duplicate).

### memberId — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignMemberId.java` (`service`, lines 29-50)
Format `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>` (persisted onto the Owner):
```java
String region = Locality.of(owner.getCity(), owner.getPostcode());
String hash8  = Sha256.hex(telephone + lastName).substring(0, 8).toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
String fy     = String.format("%02d", FiscalYear.yy(owner.getRegistrationDate()));
String core   = region + fy + hash8;
String base   = core + CheckDigit.of(core);
// collision: append "-<n>" with smallest n>=2 that is unique across ownerRepository.findAll()
```
- FY: `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/FiscalYear.java` — fiscal year starts 1 July, numbered by ending year; `yy` = last two digits.
- CHK: `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/CheckDigit.java` — Luhn over decimal digits only (letters ignored).
- Note HASH8 uses `telephone + lastName` (no separator), distinct from identityKey's construction.

Supporting hashers/helpers:
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/Sha256.java` — `hex()` returns full 64-char lower-case hex SHA-256 (the one digest point).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/Soundex.java` — American Soundex, first letter + 3 digits, used by identityKey and soft-match.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/TelephoneE164.java` — E.164 normalization (+61 default, drops leading 0; length checks +61→9, +1→10 national digits).

---

## Where locality and timezone are "set"

Neither is persisted. Both are derived read-only in the mapper at response time.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`:
  - `locality` (lines 29-30): `Locality.ofMemberId(owner.getMemberId())` — i.e. the leading letters of the persisted memberId.
  - `timezone` (lines 31-32): `Timezone.of(Locality.ofMemberId(owner.getMemberId()))`.
- Timezone table — `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/Timezone.java`: `NSW→Australia/Sydney, VIC→Australia/Melbourne, QLD→Australia/Brisbane`, else `null`.

There is a subtle inconsistency: the OpenAPI doc for `locality` says it is derived from city, but the actual mapper derives it from the memberId's region segment (which itself was postcode-first). For a known city+postcode these agree.

---

## Owner segment computation — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerSegment.java`
```java
public static String of(String locality, Integer membershipLevel) {
    String tier = membershipLevel != null && membershipLevel >= 3 ? "PREMIUM" : "STANDARD";
    String area = Set.of("NSW","VIC","QLD").contains(locality) ? "METRO" : "REGIONAL";
    return tier + "_" + area;
}
```
Called in mapper (lines 33-34) with `Locality.ofMemberId(memberId)` and `owner.getMembershipLevel()`. One of `PREMIUM_METRO / PREMIUM_REGIONAL / STANDARD_METRO / STANDARD_REGIONAL`.

---

## Audit event schema and emission

- Event record — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerCreatedEvent.java`:
```java
public record OwnerCreatedEvent(long seq, Integer ownerId, String memberId,
        Integer membershipLevel, String event) {
    public static final String OWNER_CREATED = "OWNER_CREATED";
}
```
- Emitter — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java` (`service`, lines 31-39): logs to a dedicated `"AUDIT"` SLF4J logger:
  1. Human-readable line: `Owner created id={} memberId={} registrationDate={} membershipLevel={}`.
  2. JSON of `OwnerCreatedEvent` with a monotonic `AtomicLong SEQ`, `owner.getId()`, `primaryIdentifier(owner)` (= `owner.getMemberId()`, lines 42-44), `membershipLevel`, and constant `event="OWNER_CREATED"`.
  Uses `tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper` for serialization.

---

## Owner response shape

- Responders: `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/RespondWithOwner.java` (GET) and `RespondWithOwnerCreated.java` (POST → 201 with `Location: /api/owners/{id}`); both call `ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner)`.
- Actual computed fields (all `@Mapping` expressions in `OwnerMapper.toOwnerDto`, lines 21-49): `displayName` (`Last, First`), `initials`, `salutation`, `telephoneDisplay`, `householdId`, `identityKey`, `locality`, `timezone`, `ownerSegment`, `contactPreference` (EMAIL/PHONE), `ageBand` (`AgeBand.of`), `fiscalYear` (`FiscalYear.label`), `selfLink`, `riskFlag` (`RiskFlag.of`). Plus persisted passthrough fields (`memberId`, `namesakeCount`, membership fields, warnings, `possibleDuplicate*`, `deleted`, `pets`).
- Full schema definition: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`, `Owner` schema at lines 2089-2259 (extends `OwnerFields` at line 1991). Descriptions there restate each derivation. `memberId` at 2128-2133, `householdId` 2140-2145, `identityKey` 2146-2151, `locality` 2189-2194, `timezone` 2195-2200, `ownerSegment` 2201-2206. Currently flat — no `apiVersion`/`identity` wrapper.

Persistence model — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`: `memberId` is a persisted column (`member_id`, line 66-67). There are NO columns for householdId, identityKey, locality, timezone, or ownerSegment — all derived on read.

---

## POST pipeline order
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`: `RejectDuplicateOwner` (48, uses identityKey) → `BuildOwner` (63) → `AssignMemberId` (68) → `CountHousehold` (78) → `AssignMembershipLevel` (83) → `DetectPossibleDuplicate` (103, soft match on soundex+postcode) → `SaveOwner` (108) → `AuditOwnerCreated` (118) → `RespondWithOwnerCreated` (128). memberId is assigned before save, which is why `Locality.ofMemberId` works at response time.

Duplicate detection using identityKey:
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/RejectDuplicateOwner.java` (service lines 25-42): hard 409 on exact identityKey collision (skips soft-deleted; bypassed by `sharesHousehold=true`).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/DetectPossibleDuplicate.java` (service lines 26-58): soft match when identityKey differs but `soundex(lastName)`+postcode match; sets `possibleDuplicate`/`possibleDuplicateOf` (lowest id).

---

## Test files and what they assert

1. `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java` — single test `coreV2GroupsIdentityAndVersions` (lines 10-20): creates a `structuredOwner`, GETs it, asserts `$.apiVersion == 2`, `$.identity.memberId/identityKey/householdId` are non-empty, and top-level `$.memberId/$.identityKey/$.householdId` do NOT exist. This is the identity-v2 contract (currently unimplemented in main).

2. `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java` — black-box base. Pins the same reference tables the production code uses: `CITY_REGION` (228-229), `REGION_TIMEZONE` (232-233), `REGION_POSTCODES` (236-237), `HOLIDAYS` (240-242). Reimplements `sha256hex` (282-294), `shaHex` (upper, first n, 296-299), `luhn` (302-321), `toBusinessDay` (268-274), `region`/`timezone`/`validPostcode` helpers. Provides `ownerNode`/`structuredOwner`/`knownOwner` payload builders and create/get helpers. `structuredOwner` (136-142) uses `addressLine1` + postcode `2000` (NSW).

3. `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java` — Logback `ListAppender` attached to the `"AUDIT"` logger; helpers `messages()`, `anyContains(...)`, `anyAtLevel(level,...)`, `count()`. Confirms the audit contract keys off the `AUDIT` logger that `AuditOwnerCreated` writes to. Not referenced by the current single test, but is the harness for asserting audit side-effects.

No JUnit tests exist for the individual derivation helpers directly; they are exercised through the black-box acceptance layer.

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/TelephoneE164.java` — E.164 normalization (+61 default, drops leading 0; length checks +61→9, +1→10 national digits).

---

## Where locality and timezone are "set"

Neither is persisted. Both are derived read-only in the mapper at response time.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`:
  - `locality` (lines 29-30): `Locality.ofMemberId(owner.getMemberId())` — i.e. the leading letters of the persisted memberId.
  - `timezone` (lines 31-32): `Timezone.of(Locality.ofMemberId(owner.getMemberId()))`.
- Timezone table — `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/Timezone.java`: `NSW→Australia/Sydney, VIC→Australia/Melbourne, QLD→Australia/Brisbane`, else `null`.

There is a subtle inconsistency: the OpenAPI doc for `locality` says it is derived from city, but the actual mapper derives it from the memberId's region segment (which itself was postcode-first). For a known city+postcode these agree.

---

## Owner segment computation — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerSegment.java`
```java
public static String of(String locality, Integer membershipLevel) {
    String tier = membershipLevel != null && membershipLevel >= 3 ? "PREMIUM" : "STANDARD";
    String area = Set.of("NSW","VIC","QLD").contains(locality) ? "METRO" : "REGIONAL";
    return tier + "_" + area;
}
```
Called in mapper (lines 33-34) with `Locality.ofMemberId(memberId)` and `owner.getMembershipLevel()`. One of `PREMIUM_METRO / PREMIUM_REGIONAL / STANDARD_METRO / STANDARD_REGIONAL`.

---

## Audit event schema and emission

- Event record — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerCreatedEvent.java`:
```java
public record OwnerCreatedEvent(long seq, Integer ownerId, String memberId,
        Integer membershipLevel, String event) {
    public static final String OWNER_CREATED = "OWNER_CREATED";
}
```
- Emitter — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java` (`service`, lines 31-39): logs to a dedicated `"AUDIT"` SLF4J logger:
  1. Human-readable line: `Owner created id={} memberId={} registrationDate={} membershipLevel={}`.
  2. JSON of `OwnerCreatedEvent` with a monotonic `AtomicLong SEQ`, `owner.getId()`, `primaryIdentifier(owner)` (= `owner.getMemberId()`, lines 42-44), `membershipLevel`, and constant `event="OWNER_CREATED"`.
  Uses `tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper` for serialization.

---

## Owner response shape

- Responders: `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/RespondWithOwner.java` (GET) and `RespondWithOwnerCreated.java` (POST → 201 with `Location: /api/owners/{id}`); both call `ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner)`.
- Actual computed fields (all `@Mapping` expressions in `OwnerMapper.toOwnerDto`, lines 21-49): `displayName` (`Last, First`), `initials`, `salutation`, `telephoneDisplay`, `householdId`, `identityKey`, `locality`, `timezone`, `ownerSegment`, `contactPreference` (EMAIL/PHONE), `ageBand` (`AgeBand.of`), `fiscalYear` (`FiscalYear.label`), `selfLink`, `riskFlag` (`RiskFlag.of`). Plus persisted passthrough fields (`memberId`, `namesakeCount`, membership fields, warnings, `possibleDuplicate*`, `deleted`, `pets`).
- Full schema definition: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`, `Owner` schema at lines 2089-2259 (extends `OwnerFields` at line 1991). Descriptions there restate each derivation. `memberId` at 2128-2133, `householdId` 2140-2145, `identityKey` 2146-2151, `locality` 2189-2194, `timezone` 2195-2200, `ownerSegment` 2201-2206. Currently flat — no `apiVersion`/`identity` wrapper.

Persistence model — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`: `memberId` is a persisted column (`member_id`, line 66-67). There are NO columns for householdId, identityKey, locality, timezone, or ownerSegment — all derived on read.

---

## POST pipeline order
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`: `RejectDuplicateOwner` (48, uses identityKey) → `BuildOwner` (63) → `AssignMemberId` (68) → `CountHousehold` (78) → `AssignMembershipLevel` (83) → `DetectPossibleDuplicate` (103, soft match on soundex+postcode) → `SaveOwner` (108) → `AuditOwnerCreated` (118) → `RespondWithOwnerCreated` (128). memberId is assigned before save, which is why `Locality.ofMemberId` works at response time.

Duplicate detection using identityKey:
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/RejectDuplicateOwner.java` (service lines 25-42): hard 409 on exact identityKey collision (skips soft-deleted; bypassed by `sharesHousehold=true`).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/DetectPossibleDuplicate.java` (service lines 26-58): soft match when identityKey differs but `soundex(lastName)`+postcode match; sets `possibleDuplicate`/`possibleDuplicateOf` (lowest id).

---

## Test files and what they assert

1. `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java` — single test `coreV2GroupsIdentityAndVersions` (lines 10-20): creates a `structuredOwner`, GETs it, asserts `$.apiVersion == 2`, `$.identity.memberId/identityKey/householdId` are non-empty, and top-level `$.memberId/$.identityKey/$.householdId` do NOT exist. This is the identity-v2 contract (currently unimplemented in main).

2. `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java` — black-box base. Pins the same reference tables the production code uses: `CITY_REGION` (228-229), `REGION_TIMEZONE` (232-233), `REGION_POSTCODES` (236-237), `HOLIDAYS` (240-242). Reimplements `sha256hex` (282-294), `shaHex` (upper, first n, 296-299), `luhn` (302-321), `toBusinessDay` (268-274), `region`/`timezone`/`validPostcode` helpers. Provides `ownerNode`/`structuredOwner`/`knownOwner` payload builders and create/get helpers. `structuredOwner` (136-142) uses `addressLine1` + postcode `2000` (NSW).

3. `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java` — Logback `ListAppender` attached to the `"AUDIT"` logger; helpers `messages()`, `anyContains(...)`, `anyAtLevel(level,...)`, `count()`. Confirms the audit contract keys off the `AUDIT` logger that `AuditOwnerCreated` writes to. Not referenced by the current single test, but is the harness for asserting audit side-effects.

No JUnit tests exist for the individual derivation helpers directly; they are exercised through the black-box acceptance layer.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "Optional honorific title of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When supplied it is combined with the last name to form the returned 'salutation'."
          type: string
          maxLength: 3
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat string for backward compatibility, but the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are preferred when supplied. On output this is the composed, normalized address: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when an addressLine2 is present."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: "First line of the owner's structured postal address (street number and name). Optional; when supplied it is preferred over the flat 'address' input, normalized (trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand common street-type abbreviations) and used to compose the returned 'address'. An owner is valid when it supplies an address in either form: a non-blank addressLine1, or the flat address."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: "Optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (unit, suite, etc.). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after a single space."
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Normalized to E.164 form on input (a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped); stored and returned in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-() +0-9]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on input; defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Must fall on a business day; if the effective date (supplied or defaulted) is a Saturday or Sunday it is rolled forward to the next Monday, and that adjusted date is stored and used for all derived values.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, bypasses the household duplicate block so this owner can be created even though another owner has the same last name and postcode (they share a household); the owner is then a declared household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. The shared householdId is derived automatically from the last name and postcode. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: true
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per a fixed region table (Sydney/NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne/VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane/QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied; a request without a postcode is still accepted."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when present the owner's ageBand is derived from it (relative to the registrationDate).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: "Franklin, George"
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: "G.F."
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's salutation, formed as the title followed by a single space and the last name (e.g. 'DR Who'); just the last name when no title was supplied."
              type: string
              example: "DR Who"
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw telephone field keeps its E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: "+61 412 345 678"
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: Server-assigned member identifier formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>', where REGION is the region code derived from the owner's postcode (falling back to the city-to-region table, else 'UNKNOWN'), FY is the two-digit fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with the last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. On collision with an existing member id, '-<n>' is appended with the smallest n of 2 or more that makes it unique.
              type: string
              example: "NSW261A2B3C4D5"
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: "FY26"
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Server-assigned identifier shared by every owner with the same last name and postcode (one household). Derived deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and postcode, so owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically and it is stable across requests.
              type: string
              example: "A1B2C3D4E5F6"
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "Server-assigned key that all duplicate detection is expressed through: the lower-case hex SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty, lower-cased) + '|' + soundex(lastName). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identityKey matches; because the telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with different telephones have different identityKeys (they surface instead as a soft match). Derived deterministically, so it is stable across requests."
              type: string
              example: "3f8a1c2d4e5b6a7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b3c4d5e"
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners at creation time sharing the same firstName and lastName (case-insensitively), counted before this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "Points score assigned at creation. Starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, plus 3 for a tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year (fiscal years, starting 1 July, between the registrationDate and the current server date)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric membership level derived from membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's registration day before this owner was created, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: "True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the capacity limit of 50) before this owner was created, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The canonical region derived from the owner's city via a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table."
              type: string
              example: "NSW"
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region via a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent (null) when the region is 'UNKNOWN' or not in the table."
              type: string
              example: "Australia/Sydney"
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: "The owner's segment formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'."
              type: string
              example: "STANDARD_METRO"
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              example: "EMAIL"
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "The owner's age band derived from birthDate relative to registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent (null) when no birthDate was supplied."
              type: string
              example: "ADULT"
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: "True when this owner's identityKey differs from an existing owner's yet shares that owner's soundex(lastName) and postcode (a near-miss the identity key lets through, e.g. same household with a different telephone); otherwise false. A declared household member (created with sharesHousehold true) is never flagged."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: "When possibleDuplicate is true, the id of the existing owner (lowest id when several match) whose soundex(lastName) and postcode this owner shares; otherwise absent (null)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: "True when the owner warrants review because any of these hold: it is a possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate is true), its email domain is disposable-adjacent (a subdomain or sibling-TLD sharing the second-level label of a known disposable-email provider), or its city is over its soft capacity (the capacityWarning band); otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: "True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{id}; the record is retained. A newly created owner is false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical URI path of this owner, formed as '/api/owners/' followed by the owner id.
              type: string
              example: "/api/owners/1"
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetPage:
      title: Pet page
      description: A page of pets.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30
          example: Leo
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2010-09-07'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PetAgeValidation"
        type:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetType'
      required:
        - name
        - birthDate
        - type
    Pet:
      title: Pet
      description: A pet.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ownerId:
              title: Owner ID
              description: The ID of the pet's owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            visits:
              title: Visits
              description: Vet visit bookings for this pet.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Visit'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - id
            - type
            - visits
    VetFields:
      title: VetFields
      description: Editable fields of a veterinarian.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: 'James'
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: 'Carter'
        specialties:
          title: Specialties
          description: The specialties of the vet.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Specialty'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    Vet:
      title: Vet
      description: A veterinarian.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the vet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
      required:
        - id
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    VisitFields:
      title: Visit fields
      description: Editable fields of a vet visit.
      type: object
      properties:
        date:
          title: Date
          description: The date of the visit.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        description:
          title: Description
          description: The description for the visit.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'rabies shot'
      required:
        - description
    Visit:
      title: Visit
      description: A booking for a vet visit.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VisitFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the visit.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            petId:
              title: Pet ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
            - petId
    PetTypeFields:
      title: PetType fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet type.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet type.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: cat
      required:
        - name
    PetType:
      title: Pet type
      description: A pet type.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetTypeFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet type.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
    User:
      title: User
      description: An user.
      type: object
      properties:
        username:
          title: username
          description: The username
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: john.doe
        password:
          title: Password
          description: The password
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: 1234abc
        enabled:
          title: enabled
          description: Indicates if the user is enabled
          type: boolean
          example: true
        roles:
          title: Roles
          description: The roles of an user
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Role'
      required:
        - username
    Role:
      title: Role
      description: A role.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: name
          description: The role's name
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: admin
      required:
        - name

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwner
      summary: Get a pet owner by ID
      description: Returns the pet owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "Optional honorific title of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When supplied it is combined with the last name to form the returned 'salutation'."
          type: string
          maxLength: 3
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat string for backward compatibility, but the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are preferred when supplied. On output this is the composed, normalized address: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when an addressLine2 is present."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: "First line of the owner's structured postal address (street number and name). Optional; when supplied it is preferred over the flat 'address' input, normalized (trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand common street-type abbreviations) and used to compose the returned 'address'. An owner is valid when it supplies an address in either form: a non-blank addressLine1, or the flat address."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: "Optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (unit, suite, etc.). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after a single space."
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Normalized to E.164 form on input (a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped); stored and returned in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-() +0-9]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on input; defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Must fall on a business day; if the effective date (supplied or defaulted) is a Saturday or Sunday it is rolled forward to the next Monday, and that adjusted date is stored and used for all derived values.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, bypasses the household duplicate block so this owner can be created even though another owner has the same last name and postcode (they share a household); the owner is then a declared household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. The shared householdId is derived automatically from the last name and postcode. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: true
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per a fixed region table (Sydney/NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne/VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane/QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied; a request without a postcode is still accepted."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when present the owner's ageBand is derived from it (relative to the registrationDate).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: "Franklin, George"
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: "G.F."
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's salutation, formed as the title followed by a single space and the last name (e.g. 'DR Who'); just the last name when no title was supplied."
              type: string
              example: "DR Who"
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw telephone field keeps its E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: "+61 412 345 678"
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The version of the owner representation. Always 2 for this release.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: The owner's server-assigned identity, grouping the version-2 memberId, householdId and identityKey.
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: "FY26"
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Server-assigned identifier shared by every owner with the same last name and postcode (one household). Derived deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and postcode, so owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically and it is stable across requests.
              type: string
              example: "A1B2C3D4E5F6"
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "Server-assigned key that all duplicate detection is expressed through: the lower-case hex SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty, lower-cased) + '|' + soundex(lastName). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identityKey matches; because the telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with different telephones have different identityKeys (they surface instead as a soft match). Derived deterministically, so it is stable across requests."
              type: string
              example: "3f8a1c2d4e5b6a7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b3c4d5e"
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners at creation time sharing the same firstName and lastName (case-insensitively), counted before this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "Points score assigned at creation. Starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, plus 3 for a tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year (fiscal years, starting 1 July, between the registrationDate and the current server date)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric membership level derived from membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's registration day before this owner was created, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: "True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the capacity limit of 50) before this owner was created, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The canonical region derived from the owner's city via a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table."
              type: string
              example: "NSW"
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region via a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent (null) when the region is 'UNKNOWN' or not in the table."
              type: string
              example: "Australia/Sydney"
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: "The owner's segment formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'."
              type: string
              example: "STANDARD_METRO"
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              example: "EMAIL"
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "The owner's age band derived from birthDate relative to registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent (null) when no birthDate was supplied."
              type: string
              example: "ADULT"
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: "True when this owner's identityKey differs from an existing owner's yet shares that owner's soundex(lastName) and postcode (a near-miss the identity key lets through, e.g. same household with a different telephone); otherwise false. A declared household member (created with sharesHousehold true) is never flagged."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: "When possibleDuplicate is true, the id of the existing owner (lowest id when several match) whose soundex(lastName) and postcode this owner shares; otherwise absent (null)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag

            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'

      responses:

          description: The pet owner was successfully added.

              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'

          description: Bad request.

            application/json:

                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:

          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:

          required: false

          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.

                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
