components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "Optional honorific title of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When supplied it is combined with the last name to form the returned 'salutation'."
          type: string
          maxLength: 3
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat string for backward compatibility, but the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are preferred when supplied. On output this is the composed, normalized address: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when an addressLine2 is present."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: "First line of the owner's structured postal address (street number and name). Optional; when supplied it is preferred over the flat 'address' input, normalized (trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand common street-type abbreviations) and used to compose the returned 'address'. An owner is valid when it supplies an address in either form: a non-blank addressLine1, or the flat address."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: "Optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (unit, suite, etc.). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after a single space."
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Normalized to E.164 form on input (a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped); stored and returned in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-() +0-9]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on input; defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Must fall on a business day; if the effective date (supplied or defaulted) is a Saturday or Sunday it is rolled forward to the next Monday, and that adjusted date is stored and used for all derived values.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, bypasses the household duplicate block so this owner can be created even though another owner has the same last name and postcode (they share a household); the owner is then a declared household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. The shared householdId is derived automatically from the last name and postcode. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: true
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per a fixed region table (Sydney/NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne/VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane/QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied; a request without a postcode is still accepted."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when present the owner's ageBand is derived from it (relative to the registrationDate).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: "Franklin, George"
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: "G.F."
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's salutation, formed as the title followed by a single space and the last name (e.g. 'DR Who'); just the last name when no title was supplied."
              type: string
              example: "DR Who"
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw telephone field keeps its E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: "+61 412 345 678"
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The version of the owner representation. Always 2 for this release.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: The owner's server-assigned identity, grouping the version-2 memberId, householdId and identityKey.
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: "FY26"
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners at creation time sharing the same firstName and lastName (case-insensitively), counted before this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "Points score assigned at creation. Starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, plus 3 for a tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year (fiscal years, starting 1 July, between the registrationDate and the current server date)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric membership level derived from membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's registration day before this owner was created, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: "True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the capacity limit of 50) before this owner was created, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The canonical region derived from the owner's city via a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table."
              type: string
              example: "NSW"
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region via a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent (null) when the region is 'UNKNOWN' or not in the table."
              type: string
              example: "Australia/Sydney"
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: "The owner's segment formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'."
              type: string
              example: "STANDARD_METRO"
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              example: "EMAIL"
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "The owner's age band derived from birthDate relative to registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent (null) when no birthDate was supplied."
              type: string
              example: "ADULT"
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: "True when this owner's identityKey differs from an existing owner's yet shares that owner's soundex(lastName) and postcode (a near-miss the identity key lets through, e.g. same household with a different telephone); otherwise false. A declared household member (created with sharesHousehold true) is never flagged."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: "When possibleDuplicate is true, the id of the existing owner (lowest id when several match) whose soundex(lastName) and postcode this owner shares; otherwise absent (null)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: "True when the owner warrants review because any of these hold: it is a possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate is true), its email domain is disposable-adjacent (a subdomain or sibling-TLD sharing the second-level label of a known disposable-email provider), or its city is over its soft capacity (the capacityWarning band); otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: "True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{id}; the record is retained. A newly created owner is false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical URI path of this owner, formed as '/api/owners/' followed by the owner id.
              type: string
              example: "/api/owners/1"
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

content.text:
Green. Version 2 of the owner identity is implemented and the full test suite passes (`BUILD SUCCESS`).

## What changed

**Version-2 region code inside the identifiers** — new `RegionCode` helper derives the region code with the plain region plus a fixed `"V2"` tag mixed in. It's threaded into all three identifiers so every one changes and no v1 value recurs:
- `AssignMemberId` — `REGION` segment is now `RegionCode.v2(city, postcode)` (e.g. `NSWV2261A2B3C4D5`).
- `HouseholdId` — hashes `regionV2 + '|' + normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode` (region derived from postcode alone, so the same-lastName-and-postcode household invariant is preserved).
- `IdentityKey` — now takes `postcode` and hashes `regionV2 + '|' + …`; the three callers (`OwnerMapper`, `RejectDuplicateOwner`, `DetectPossibleDuplicate`) pass it consistently, so duplicate detection still matches.

**`locality` stays plain** — the mapper now derives `locality`, `timezone` and `ownerSegment` directly from the plain region `Locality.of(city, postcode)` (decoupled from the memberId, whose region now carries `V2`). The dead `Locality.ofMemberId` was removed. The `"V2"` tag appears only inside the identifiers.

**Response shape (v2)** — in `openapi.yml`: added top-level integer `apiVersion` (2), added an `OwnerIdentity` schema, and moved `memberId`/`householdId`/`identityKey` under a nested `identity` object (removed from top level). `OwnerMapper` maps `identity.*` and `apiVersion`.

**Audit schema v2** — `OwnerCreatedEvent` gained `schemaVersion` (`= 2`) and `ownerSegment`; `AuditOwnerCreated` emits both, with the segment recomputed from the plain region so no `V2` leaks. Observed at runtime: `{"schemaVersion":2,…,"memberId":"NSWV22716E6609E7","ownerSegment":"STANDARD_METRO","event":"OWNER_CREATED"}`.

Request fields are unchanged.

That meant adding a region component to `householdId` and `identityKey` (previously region-free).
